lead_deck: The 23rd Lycian Waterway Walk and Patara Nomad Migration event took place in Kaş
lead_body: The 23rd Lycian Waterway Walk and Patara Nomad Migration event took place in Kaş. The event highlighted the beauty of the Lycian Waterway and the importance of the Patara Nomad Migration. This event, which will contribute to tourism activities in the Kalkan and Kaş region, also showcased the region's cultural richness.
